judgments.verdict: The journal, beams, rehearsals and receipts turn effortless generation into probed questions, tested invariants and recorded trails that restore resistance and intention.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether a world restores touch when generation outruns the hand, not whether it repeats its nouns. Reading: The artefact carries that tension into connected rules to probe before building, rehearse in a copy, hold beams as resisting material and leave resolving receipts. Other levels: Level-2 would hold if only part of the loop survived as names; level-4 would need alternatives and disagreement sustained across distinct positions, which single-operator use does not show and would be falsified by evidence of bilateral challenge.

judgments.verdict: The journal, beams, rehearsals and receipts turn effortless generation into checked steps where resistance must be faced before building.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks a world to recover touch when power outruns the hand so intention becomes recognizable at scale. Reading: The apparatus carries that tension into connected checks, trials and trails that block building on failure. Other levels: Below would be word repetition without checks; above would need a grown city showing recognized intention, which a law-only apparatus does not yet show.

judgments.verdict: The apparatus turns the portal tension into a working loop of recorded questions, trial copies, holding checks and visible trails that resist and answer.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that effortless power become touchable through resistance where intention becomes recognizable at larger scale. Reading: The artefact implements probe-before-build, disposable rehearsals with diffs, holding beams and resolving receipts that together let making meet inspectable consequence; stripped of seed words the loop still resists and answers, though no domain city yet shows joy at scale. Other levels: Below would be motif repetition without causal loop, above would require demonstrated intention in a grown project with alternatives weighed; falsified if beams or rehearsals were decorative or bypassed.

judgments.verdict: One shared command set lets present and later operators act while the directory resists through failed checks and chain refusal, without a separate intelligence position.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for distinct participants meeting in material that answers both, not one hand on an instrument. Reading: The artefact shows successor handoff with attribution and material resistance, but person and intelligence share identical acts with actor as free label. Other levels: Level-1 would hold if only operator-on-instrument were visible; level-3 would need reciprocal influence shaping continuation, falsified by absence of any act only the other can perform.

judgments.verdict: All six gestures run through one operator channel with a free actor label, leaving the material to resist but no intelligence with its own say.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for distinct person, intelligence and material meeting where each can shape and be shaped. Reading: One operator holds every gesture while the world only executes checks, so use is instrumental despite real friction. Other levels: Below would erase even material friction; above would need visible two-way shaping with attribution and disagreement, which would require a separate intelligence channel.

judgments.verdict: One operator holds all shaping gestures while the material answers through checks and chain refusal, without a distinct intelligence position.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for distinct person, intelligence and material meeting where each shapes the shared continuation in both directions. Reading: All six gestures share one append path under a free-text actor and are retireable unilaterally, so intelligence has no operational position distinct from operator and joint change needs no bilateral accept; material does answer via beam failures and chain refusal. Other levels: Below would be no roles at all, above would need reciprocal shaping with attribution and disagreement preserved; falsified if intelligence could refuse or propose under its own constraints or shared change required both.

judgments.verdict: Declared refusals and chain refusal let an operator limit action, but no shared change requires agreement or allows withdrawal preserving both contributions.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether each side can accept, question, limit or withdraw from a shared direction under declared constraints. Reading: Boundaries, retire and resolve record operator limits and broken-chain refusal blocks appends, yet any operator can add if chain holds with no bilateral gate. Other levels: Level-0 would hold if no boundary were expressed; level-2 would need both positions able to state dispositions requiring uptake, falsified by finding a check where the other must concur.

judgments.verdict: Boundaries and retire rules record what one operator will not do, but no shared change needs both sides to agree or allows joint withdrawal.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that cooperation let each side accept, limit or step back from a shared direction. Reading: Refusals exist as unilateral entries and any writer can close or retire alone without bilateral acceptance. Other levels: Below would have no refusal at all; above would need a change that opens only on mutual agreement and preserves revisability, which single-channel append cannot enforce.

judgments.verdict: Declared refusals exist but any operator can record or retire them alone, so no shared direction requires agreement or preserves withdrawal.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that each participant be able to accept, question, limit or withdraw from a shared direction under declared constraints. Reading: Four refusals are declared but recorded unilaterally and retireable by any later receipt; chain refusal and beam failure block automatically yet without expressing a participant disposition. Other levels: Below would be no boundary at all, above would need both positions able to bound and shared change requiring both; falsified if retirement required originator or counterparty consent.

judgments.verdict: Rehearsals in a disposable copy with diffs and outputs, beam runs and resolve-or-retire receipts form a loop where resistance returns into the next choice.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for a closed loop where intention meets resistance, exposes consequence and returns into choice. Reading: Rehearsal shows would-change files and output, beams report pass-fail, and wake briefing directs repair before building with receipts closing probes. Other levels: Level-2 would hold if consequences were only inspectable without revision; level-4 would need local edits and wider invariants staying linked across rehearsal, falsified because beams run in the world rather than inside the copy.

judgments.verdict: Rehearsals in disposable copies, beam checks and receipts link trying, failing and revising so consequences return into next choices.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that a move meet resistance, show consequence and feed that consequence back into choice. Reading: Copy trials with diffs plus beam briefings and closing receipts form a coherent loop from intent through friction to revision. Other levels: Below would be narrated feedback without inspection; above would need local edits tied to wider propagation, which single-witness isolation and refused outside reach do not provide.

judgments.verdict: Trial copies, holding checks and closing receipts form a coherent cycle where resistance blocks building and returns into revision.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that a contribution meet resistance, expose consequence, and return it into the next choice. Reading: Rehearsals run in disposable copies with snapshots, exits and tails, beams run from root on every wake, sleep and verify with nonzero exits blocking building, and receipts close the loop; the loop survives word-stripping as behaviour. Other levels: Below would be narrated feedback only, above would need local edits staying linked to wider witnesses across time; falsified if rehearsals touched the world or failures were advisory, and weakened because the git witness is absent and beams are retireable.

judgments.verdict: Standard-library Python, readable records, one-command wake and smallest beam-checkable steps show a coherent practical direction with explicit limits and alternatives.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for grounded choices of medium and scope where a question selects which world deserves to exist. Reading: The maker selects portable stdlib, JSONL plus Markdown, single wake and beam-first minimalism with limits and growth sketches made legible. Other levels: Level-2 would hold if direction were relevant but ungrounded; level-4 would need explicit rejected alternatives weighed while opening a new project, falsified by growth ideas remaining suggestions not pursued.

judgments.verdict: Stdlib-only, human-readable journal, one-command wake and smallest beam-tested steps show purposeful medium and scope tied to the story grammar.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for grounded choices of what to build and what comes next with additions made legible. Reading: Medium and scope cohere around legibility and verifiability, and growth sketches are separated from orders. Other levels: Below would be arbitrary tooling; above would need explicit rejected alternatives alongside a new city direction, which remains only suggested.

judgments.verdict: Stdlib, readable records, one-command waking and smallest verifiable steps show a coherent legible direction that defers the city.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for grounded choices of medium, scope and next steps where additions stay legible. Reading: Stdlib-only Python, human-readable JSONL and Markdown, one-command wake and smallest beam-verifiable steps cohere with probes and tests, and growth sketches plus limits are documented; yet the city remains unchosen by design. Other levels: Below would be weak seed connection, above would require explicit rejected alternatives alongside an opened new direction; falsified if medium or scope lacked rationale or additions hid in unrecorded edits.

judgments.verdict: Questions, constraints, checks, refusals, trial copies and trails become stored behaviours with checks and consequences rather than remaining as names alone.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks what survives as relation when a conjecture becomes artefacts, not which words persist. Reading: Several relations become structure that would hold without story words, while companion bilaterality narrows and fork plus git gaps are stated openly. Other levels: Level-2 would hold if only vocabulary survived with narrowing; level-4 would need relational depth preserved with additions and omissions fully explicit, falsified by loss of distinct intelligence position.

judgments.verdict: Gesture relations become runnable structure with gaps left legible, though bilateral companionship narrows to instrument use.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks what of roles and meeting survives when conjecture becomes runnable things. Reading: Several relations stay traceable in behavior that would survive renaming, while companion mutuality and elder framing fall away explicitly. Other levels: Below would be vocabulary without structure; above would need preserved relational depth plus explicit accounting of every addition and loss, which single-operator collapse prevents.

judgments.verdict: Several seed relations become working structure with explicit limits and unknowns, while joint mutuality narrows to single-operator use.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks what survives, transforms or remains unresolved when conjecture becomes artefacts. Reading: Question, constraint, invariant, refusal, trial and trail become implemented acts with checks and consequences, and incompleteness is kept as trail-not-lock with lagging snapshot; bilateral companion relation narrows to single-operator instrument. Other levels: Below would be vocabulary without structure, above would preserve joint depth while making additions and omissions explicit; falsified if behaviours vanished when words were removed or if joint agreement were implemented.

judgments.verdict: Wake briefing, status views, open probes and sleep-plus-commit instructions let a later mind recover state and redirect while keeping history legible.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for an ending that answers without closing so a successor can recover intention and change direction. Reading: Journal plus handoff, chain plus beams briefing, recent trail and open questions give a durable entry that invites replacement with reasons. Other levels: Level-2 would hold if only a narrow durable step existed; level-4 would need several grounded directions reopening the joint relation, falsified by succession staying within one operator instrument.

judgments.verdict: Wake briefing, authoritative journal, open probes and sleep-then-commit let a newcomer recover state and choose a next move.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that an ending stay open so a successor can recover intention and redirect while keeping work legible. Reading: State, intention and undecided questions are briefed together with a usable entry that refuses broken chains. Other levels: Below would describe steps without entry; above would need several enacted directions reopening the joint relation, which suggestions alone do not provide.

judgments.verdict: Handoff notes, one-command verification, full history and open questions let a newcomer resume, redirect and keep earlier work visible.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that telling stay open so a successor can recover intention and change direction while keeping work legible. Reading: Read-continuing, run wake, work journal and sleep-then-commit plus authoritative chained journal, status and log briefings, git-init instruction and five open probes give a usable entry that reopens direction and invites replacement with reasons. Other levels: Below would be described step without entry, above would support several grounded cities while reopening the joint relation under change; falsified if wake failed, chain were unverifiable, or history were editable.

judgments.verdict: Handbooks, help text and the command set use the same six acts to make the loop from question to trail perceptible and usable.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for forms that let touch and stance be perceived, not decoration over dispensing answers. Reading: Prose guides, CLI labels, status rendering and executable wake together express probe through receipt as one usable practice. Other levels: Level-2 would hold if only fragments communicated; level-4 would need expression and consequential interaction forming an accessible whole across distinct participants, falsified by collapsed roles limiting who is addressed.

judgments.verdict: Docs, CLI labels, status briefing and tests work together so the probe-chisel-beam-boundary-rehearsal-receipt reading can be used, not just named.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for forms where questioning, holding and trailing intention become perceptible in use. Reading: Prose, runnable checks and listings reinforce one another into a usable interpretation beyond fragments. Other levels: Below would be scattered naming; above would need consequential interaction as an accessible whole across wider media, which text-only workbench does not claim.

judgments.verdict: Docs, journal structure and briefings work together to make the intended meeting usable and perceptible in practice.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks that language, structure and interaction together make the meeting perceptible. Reading: Story vocabulary, directory-plus-journal structure, CLI briefings and wake script cohere into a clear usable form where resistance is perceptible in use; stripping words leaves the loop intact, though without visual media. Other levels: Below would be fragmentary communication, above would be fully accessible consequential interaction across media; falsified if forms obscured relations or interaction were non-consequential.

presentation.title: From conjecture to continuation
presentation.summary: Rubric judgments resolve 8 of 8 axes from 3 independent evidence sessions; each axis has its own quorum.
findings: Core recognition: Carries the central tension into several connected choices.
Shared agency: A single operator acts on an instrument.
Mutual consent: Operator choice or resource refusal is represented.
Consequential touch: Rehearsal, resistance and revision form a coherent loop.
Independent judgment: Medium, scope and choices have a coherent source-grounded rationale.
Fidelity through change: Several source relations remain traceable through design and behaviour.
Open continuation: State, intention and an open question support a recoverable next move.
Expressive coherence: The chosen forms work together to make the reading perceptible.
